doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

title: Donaldsonville guitar player Joey Sales
summary: Allen asks about guitarist Joey Sales and his son Manuel; Edna only knows the name.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: I was thinking, trying to think about some of the people I know of from Donaldsonville. There was a guitar player named Joey Sales or something. But I guess he moved down here. Joey Sales?
His son is Manuel Sales. He also plays the guitar here. He's telling me. I just thought you might have run across here.
